This is the Steering Knuckle Rebuild Kit plus the Complete Front Axle Rebuild Kit.
Includes the Knuckle Bearings PLUS the Axle Bearings.
Get everything you need to completely Rebuild the front-end.
DOES BOTH SIDES!
Direct Replacement

Qty 2 – Front Axle Outer Bearings
Qty 2 – Front Axles Inner Oil Seals
Qty 2 – Front Axles Outer Oil Seals
Qty 4 – Steering Knuckle Bearings
Qty 2 – Shims for King Pins
Qty 2 – Steering Knuckle Oil Seals

Qty 4 – Steering Knuckle Oil Seal Cover Plates

Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
